subject: Berlin Summit: data handoff and attribution follow-up
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Smith <emma.smith@citywire.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:17:00 +0100
Subject: Berlin Summit — post-event data handoff and quick asks

Hi Emma,

Thanks again to you and the CityWire team for a smooth event in Berlin. We put a lot of energy into the booth and the sessions; the SDRs have a few follow-ups in flight. To close our internal reporting this week we need a clean handoff of the sponsor data so we can reconcile pipeline/credit. Can you send: 

- Final attendee CSV with email, company, job title, and opt-in flag (UTM/lead_source columns included if possible)
- Impressions and on-site session counts for the sponsor track (by hour if available)
- Any clickstream/landing page logs that tie back to booth traffic (even a sample)

I’ve attached a small snapshot we generated onsite (initial_attendee_snapshot.csv) so you can see the columns we expect.

We’re primarily reconciling leads against HubSpot (DEAL-9231) and want to avoid double-crediting. Vanessa will be our point for mapping rules. Can we get the CSV + session counts by EOD Friday (Nov 27)? If you need extra time, confirm a target and we’ll adjust reporting deadlines.

Appreciate it —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Field Marketing (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_attendee_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)
From: Emma Smith <emma.smith@citywire.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Event Operations <ops@citywire-events.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Berlin Summit — post-event data handoff and quick asks

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the note and the snapshot. We’re finalising the sponsor package now; attaching a short report with session-level totals and an export of the registration table. We still need to run the clickstream joins to map some mobile badge-swipe events, which is why the registration export is separate.

Deliverables attached: 
- berlin_registration_export.csv (registration table)
- berlin_session_summary.pdf (session totals)

We expect the full sponsor Excel (with hour-by-hour impressions and the clickstream sample) on Monday, Nov 29. Does Monday work for you? If not I can prioritize a partial delivery earlier.

—Emma
Emma Smith
Sponsorship Lead, CityWire Events

Attachments: berlin_registration_export.csv, berlin_session_summary.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Emma Smith <emma.smith@citywire.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:26:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Berlin Summit — post-event data handoff and quick asks

Emma / team —

Quick flag from our end after loading the registration export: HubSpot is showing ~34 MQLs we expected to attribute to the CityWire booth but only 22 of those map to the email list you shared. The delta looks like: 

- 6 entries are missing emails (bad badge scans)
- 3 MQLs attributed via paid campaigns (utm_medium=cpc) that we think should be credited to the sponsorship according to our internal rules

Can you confirm whether CityWire includes paid campaign UTM attribution in the sponsor CSV or if that lives in an external ad feed? Also, can you share raw badge-swipe/mobile-scanner logs (even a subset) so we can match by event_id/timestamp rather than email?

If we can’t reconcile the 12-lead gap with the files you already mentioned, we may need to agree a backfill rule (e.g., distribute the 12 leads pro-rata across sponsor contacts with verified engagement). That’s an operational lift so flagging it now.

Vanessa Ortiz
Field Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Berlin Summit — post-event data handoff and quick asks

Team —

Thanks Emma, this is helpful. To reduce back-and-forth on the 12-lead delta, propose we adopt a short mutual action plan: 

1) CityWire provides the badge-swipe logs for the top 3 sponsor hours plus a 48-hour clickstream sample (csv) by EOD Monday Nov 29.
2) Redwood will run a deterministic join first (email / fingerprint / phone) and then a probabilistic join for remaining unmatched records and share a reconciliation table with confidence bands by Wed Dec 2.
3) If after that there are unmatched MQLs we escalate to a single backfill rule: prorate unmatched MQLs across sponsor leads who had >=2 interactions (page view + session attendance).

We’ll open a shared Sheet (linked below) so both teams can see the mapping and agree on final credit. Also attaching our recommended UTM mapping so you can backfill paid-campaign overlap.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Rev Ops, Redwood Inference

Related link: https://hubspot.com/contacts/DEAL-9231
Attachment: redwood_utm_mapping_v1.csv
From: Emma Smith <emma.smith@citywire.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Berlin Summit — post-event data handoff and quick asks

Hi all,

Apologies for the delay — attached is the full sponsor workbook and a zip with the high-res booth photos. We included: 

- CityWire_Sponsor_Report_Q4.xlsx: hour-by-hour impressions, session attendance, and the badge-swipe sample (event_id + timestamp + device_id).
- Booth-Photos.zip: final imagery for post-event social and collateral.

Regarding the 12-lead gap: the missing emails were primarily onsite scans where attendees chose to withhold email at registration (mobile check-in flow). The paid-campaign UTM hits are delivered via our ad partner feed — included as an additional tab in the workbook (utm_overlaps). I think following Karthik’s plan will get us to parity quickly.

If you want to lock credits this week, I’m available for a 30-minute reconciliation call Tue Nov 30 09:00-11:00 CET. Otherwise we can aim for Wed Dec 2 for the shared-sheet review.

Best,
Emma Smith
Sponsorship Lead, CityWire Events

Attachments: CityWire_Sponsor_Report_Q4.xlsx, Booth-Photos.zip
